form_calculation.description: Rolling 5-match form on raw stats for player's position group, z-scored. Bench minutes excluded to isolate playing form.

positional_benchmark.description: 0-100 scale where 50 = peer group median. Standardized within position group when at least min_position_coverage of the competition pool has a known position, otherwise across the whole competition (partial coverage would make the composite incomparable across players). player_ratings.rating_basis records which applied.

contribution_rating.description: GIGOT input #5. Player's share of his own team's match output per stat group, blended (weights sum = 1.0), then percentile-scaled within his own competition so the median contributor = 50. Read by gigot_contribution.py; written to the DB only by regenerate_full.py.

data_quality_thresholds.description: min_minutes_for_form: a match counts toward Form/Class only above this. min_rate_coverage: a stat counts toward the composite only if more than this share of the pool's rows carry a non-zero value - post-contact metres are absent before 2025 and would otherwise consume a quarter of a prop's weight as a dead input. Weights are renormalised over the stats that remain.

_note: Only settings the code actually reads live here. Removed 2026-08-25: rating_weights and class_calculation (the latter described an ELO mechanism for player Class that the engine does not use - Class is a shrunk mean of position-standardized composites), competition_translation_model (the fitted model and its feature list live in translation_model_v2.pkl), and weekly_update_schedule (weekly_update.py takes its arguments on the command line). Unused keys that describe a mechanism the code does not implement are worse than no documentation.
